description: Search the Wayback Machine CDX API for archived versions of a URL. Supports match types (exact/prefix/host/domain), date range filtering, collapsing duplicates, field filtering, pagination, and duplicate counting.

collapse.description: Collapse adjacent duplicates by field, e.g. "timestamp:8" (per hour), "digest" (unique content)

filter.description: Filter by field regex, e.g. ["statuscode:200", "!mimetype:image.*"]. Prefix with ! to negate.

matchType.description: URL match scope: exact (default), prefix (all under path), host, or domain (with subdomains)

resolveRevisits.description: Resolve warc/revisit entries to their original mimetype and status code

showDupeCount.description: Show duplicate count per capture (grouped by digest)

url.description: The URL pattern to search for

name: search_archives
